description: Start adding a tool that Agent Charts doesn't list yet to its list of sellers: an API, an MCP server or a paid endpoint that AI agents can use. Only for the owner of the tool, on a domain the owner controls, with details taken from the tool's own site. Returns a code, a private token, the entry as it will be published and the value to publish on the domain, as a file or a DNS TXT record, to prove the domain; then call finish_add. Nothing shows until finish_add succeeds and the entry has been read. The row gets the label "Added by the seller", with no rank and no numbers. A domain that is listed already returns an error with its claim link. At most 5 new services a day. Free, no sign-in.

category.description: The one category that fits best

domain.description: The tool's host, such as example.com or api.example.com. The code goes on this host; a leading www. is dropped

line.description: One line on what it does, up to 120 characters. Shown

link.description: Where people and agents go, starting with https://. Shown

logo.description: An https:// link to a PNG, JPG or WebP of at most 512 KB, with no redirect. Shown

name.description: The tool's name, up to 40 characters. Shown

pays.description: Every way agents pay for it: x402, mpp, card (a card or an API key) or free

name: add_service
